title: SSR example: Frames and Fetch panels (Effect-wired)
description: Add the animation_frames and from_fetch panels to examples/leptos-ssr with signals created at component level and pipelines wired inside Effect::new; the fetch trigger is a counter signal so the view captures nothing non-Send. Node wasm tests for wire_frames/wire_loader under the hydrate feature; SSR render test asserts the initial markup.
